reasoning_content: The lockfile generated. Now build xoev-adapter with the lockfile. But note the Dockerfile uses `--mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock`. Now it should succeed. But there are secrets with UV_INDEX_USERNAME/PASSWORD - if pyproject doesn't reference private index, dummy secrets are fine. Let's build.
